_comment: PLACEHOLDER DATA. Replace 'friends' with real picks once collected. Each 'predictions' array is an ORDERED list of 20 team short_names, index 0 = predicted 1st place, index 19 = predicted last place. Use FPL short_name codes (ARS, MCI, LIV, ...) matching data/bootstrap-static.json's teams[].short_name - full names and a few common nicknames also work, see TEAM_ALIASES in scripts/season-vault.js. Use first names/nicknames only for friends, not full names, since this repo is public.
